reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is user-facing chat message control in DSH: it surfaces unread steering messages while a model is running and lets users recall one or all pending messages before the model reads them. The evidence shows this is implemented through DSH conversation queue/removal behavior in the client UI and optional host-side inbox removal, so its impact is scoped to in-session message lifecycle management rather than broad system automation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 聊天实用插件，在模型未读取插话消息时在输入区上方展示未读消息，并支持单条或全部撤回。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness chat utility plugin that shows unread steering messages above the input area and lets you recall one or all of them before the model reads them.

capabilities: Shows unread/steering messages in a dedicated conversation-input strip
Supports bulk clearing of pending unread messages
Uses DSH queue update or host inbox removal path to modify pending message state
Shows user feedback after recall actions

reasons.code: README documents a strip UI in `conversation.input.dock` listing sent-but-unread messages and providing per-item and all-recall actions.

README states recall is performed via `session.updateQueue(itemId, { kind: 'remove' })` and a host path using `agents.get(sessionId).inbox.remove(itemId)`, which confirms queue/state mutation capability.
Package metadata targets DSH web plugin execution (`dsh` field with web client bundle configuration), indicating this capability is applied within the chat runtime rather than external services.
